_comment: Drum note remap between GS / GM Level 2 files and the QY100's XG kits. See ../docs/performance-shaping.md ('Drums: GS and GM2 files play the wrong sounds on the QY100'). Apply to drum channels only.
certainty: [M] QY100 note names from the Data List p. 4 (Standard Kit), which also shows notes 85 to 87 empty. [D] pairs matched by sound name. 25 and 26 exist only on GS kits from the SC-88 onward.
xg_to_gm2_note: 19 and 29 map to GS-only notes (26, 25); use them only for GS targets.
